ብርት: ብርት — (?) a metal or common material; word unconfirmed (compare Amharic ብረት 'iron')

ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)

ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
በእከየ: እከይ — in the evil of (በ- + construct)
ልበ: ልብ — heart (construct 'heart of') · accusative 'the heart' (ያስተፈሥሕ ልበ 'it gladdens the heart')

ኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, construct state 'sin-of') · accusative object, 'sin' (ያአትት ኀጢአተ 'he takes away sin')

ጠቢብ: ጠቢብ — wise, a wise man (adjective used as noun)

ወአቅተሎ: አቅተለ — and he had him killed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ቀተለ, q-t-l, + -ኦ 'him')
በምክረ: ምክር — by the counsel of (በ- + construct)
እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ቀተሎ: ቀተለ — he killed him (3m sg perfect + -o, q-t-l)
ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died'
ወሰሎሞንሰ: ሰሎሞን — and Solomon, indeed (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
እኁሁ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — woman, wife (noun, fem., construct / accusative)
ስማ: ስም — her name (noun + -ኣ '3fs her', written ስማ)
ወበእንተሰ: በእንተ — and concerning indeed (ወ- + በእንተ + emphatic -ሰ)
ለክሙ: ለ — to you, for you (preposition ለ- with 2mp suffix -ክሙ)
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
